book.title: Rom Nalob̃ulat napisulan aPol totosi van hǝn alat a Rom

content: Nadǝlomian siApraham
Ginamit namttovi Ju, ivoi hǝn namtb̃inau aApraham tovi atǝmanamit ta sutuai. Datb̃isor husur nap̃isal hǝn nǝvanuan b̃egǝm b̃inor len nǝhon aGot, aApraham isab̃i ke imabe?
AGot tǝsab̃ aApraham tanor len nǝhon husur natit aApraham togol gail, aApraham tǝkad natesua hǝn tasor patpat gai mǝhat lan. Be sǝmaienan. Avan ideh salǝboi b̃isor patpat gai mǝhat len nǝhon aGot.
Husur natosian siGot ike, “AApraham edǝlom na-kel-gati-an siGot, ale husur natenan aGot eriŋi ke tovi vanuan nanoran.”
Nǝvanuan toum, nap̃urp̃uran san savi naviolan, be evi p̃urp̃uran hǝn nauman san.

Be datsǝmaienan mai aGot. AGot evi aGot toriŋi ke nǝvanuan nǝsaan lunor len nǝhon. AGot sariŋi ke galit lunor len nǝhon hum tovi nap̃urp̃uran hǝn nauman salito, be eriŋi ke lunor len nǝhon hum tovi naviolan husur nadǝlomian lotokade lan.
Mitinau aTevit tokǝmaienan, nǝboŋ tosor husur nahǝhaṽuran silat aGot toriŋi ke galit lotonor len nǝhon, naut kǝmas nauman salit gail. ATevit ike,

content.text: “Alat aGot torub̃at na-b̃ur-kotov-nalo-an salit gail dan galito,
Alat aGot tokas kuv nǝkabut salit hǝn nǝsaan salit gail,
husur aGot asike itos gat nǝsaan salito gail am hum nǝkabut salito.”

content: Be nahǝhaṽuran enan, ipat m̃os alat lotokad na-tiv-dalusi-an ŋa? Ao! Ipat m̃os galito mai alat lǝsǝkade sal. Husur datuke, “AApraham edǝlom na-kel-gati-an siGot, ale husur natenan aGot eriŋi ke tovi vanuan nanoran.”
Be natenan evisi ŋais? Evisi a m̃o len na-tiv-dalusi-an siApraham o a tahw lan? Imasil ke aGot eriŋi ke tovi nǝvanuan nanoran nǝboŋ sǝkad na-tiv-dalusi-an sal.

Na-tiv-dalusi-an aApraham tokade a tahw, evi nǝ-ta-gati-an togol top̃arp̃ar ke, aGot toriŋi ke, inor len nǝhon. Imaienan, imasil ke aApraham ikad navoivoian mai aGot bathut nadǝlomian tokade tia ale na-tiv-dalusi-an san egǝm a tahw. Imaienan aApraham evi atǝmalit p̃isi lotokad nadǝlomian be lǝsǝkad na-tiv-dalusi-an. AGot eriŋi ke lunor len nǝhon bathut nadǝlomian salito.
Ale alat lotokad na-tiv-dalusi-an, lǝb̃ikad nadǝlomian top̃itoṽ hum nadǝlomian aApraham atǝmadat tokade nǝboŋ sǝkad na-tiv-dalusi-an sal, aApraham evi atǝman alatenan am.
Len nadǝlomian datukad na-kel-gati-an siGot

Sutuai aGot ikel gati ke tilav navile a pan mai aApraham mai nǝpasusan san gail. Nǝboŋ aGot tokel na-kel-gati-an enan, savi husur aApraham togol husur nalo, be husur, len nadǝlomian aApraham tokade lan, aGot eriŋi ke inor len nǝhon.
Husur na-kel-gati-an siGot tǝpat m̃os alat lotogol husur nalo ŋai, nadǝlomian asike tavi natideh, ale na-kel-gati-an enan san asike tǝsarpoh.
Be nalo igol nǝpanismen siGot egǝm hǝn alat lotob̃ur kotovi. Be nalo tab̃uer, na-b̃ur-kotov-nalo-an am tab̃uer.

Imaienan, len nadǝlomian ŋai aGot eriŋi ke gidat datunor len nǝhon, hǝn datb̃ikad na-viol-kǝmas-an san, hǝn nǝpasusan siApraham p̃isi lǝb̃ikad nǝsa aGot tokel gati. Ale datb̃ikad nadǝlomian len aGot sum̃an aApraham, dereh datikad nǝsa aGot tokel gati, naut kǝmas dattovi Ju dattokad nalo o datsǝmaienan. Husur aApraham evi tata sidat p̃isi dattokad nadǝlomian.

Hum aGot tokel maii len natosian san ke, “Nugol gaiug govi tata sinaluṽoh hǝn nǝvanuan naut tiltile gail.” Len nǝhon aGot, aApraham evi atǝmadato husur ikad nadǝlomian len aGot tolav nǝmauran mai alat lotomat, ikad nadǝlomian len aGot tokis nǝsa tob̃uer, ale natit evisi.

Naut kǝmas nǝ-lon-uri-an, len nǝ-vatvat-viri-an, aApraham ikad nadǝlomian hǝn b̃egǝm vi tata sinaluṽoh hǝn nǝvanuan naut tiltile gail, hum aGot tokel maii ke, “Nalilim̃eso gotorisi, nǝpasusan sam̃ dereh lisob̃ur maienan.”
Ale nadǝlomian siApraham sateh naut kǝmas nǝdam̃ han pǝpadaŋ tovi 100; naut kǝmas tonau ke niben pǝpadaŋ hǝn tomat mai aSarah tobutoh.
Gai sariŋ gab̃ulan na-kel-gati-an siGot. Eriŋ nǝlon len aGot gol ke nadǝlomian san idaŋ am, ale isal suh nǝyalyalan siGot.
AApraham inau lǝboii ke aGot elǝboi b̃igol natideh tokel gati.
Ale husur nadǝlomian san, aGot eriŋi ke tovi vanuan nanoran.
Natosian enan toke “aGot eriŋi ke tovi vanuan nanoran” sǝpat m̃os aApraham ŋai.
Natosian enan ipat m̃os gidato am. Ikel gati ke aGot togol aYesu, aMasta sidato, tole mǝhat dan nǝmatan, datb̃eriŋ nǝlodato lan, dereh teriŋi ke dattonor len nǝhon.
AGot idam̃ hǝn nǝmatan siYesu sil nǝsaan sidato, ale igol aYesu ile mǝhat dan nǝmatan hǝn datb̃inor len nǝhon aGot.

footnotes.text: 4.4 Gǝb̃eum sivan ideh am, nauman gotogole evi nǝkabut gai tokade len gaiug, nauman sam̃ igol gai ikabut sam̃. Natenan igol nap̃urp̃uran sam̃ savi naviolan, be gai isar gel nǝkabut san.
4.15 Nalo eṽusan nǝsaan sidato, be salǝboi b̃ilav kuv nǝpanismen sile dan gidato.
